description.narrative: The development objective of the First Water and Sanitation Project for Malawi is to increase access to improved water supply and sanitation services in Blantyre Metropolitan Area, and to enhance the operational and financial efficiency of the Blantyre Water Board (BWB). The project comprises of five components. The first component, water supply improvements will be implemented by the BWB and will finance investments in water production (motivated by the increase in flood frequency and breakdowns at the existing water treatment plant), network stabilization, leak reduction, renewable energy sources, and water network expansion to unserved areas, thereby lowering greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and boosting water access. The second component, priority sanitation investments will finance interventions to increase access to improved sanitation and reduce environmental pollution that impacts public health, thus contributing to the global crisis response framework (GCRF) pillar 3 on climate resilience. The third component, institutional capacity strengthening will finance a set of institutional development activities. The fourth component, (TA) technical assistance and project management support will finance TA to support the project implementation unit (PIU) and the incremental operating costs for project management, including environment and social risks, communications, and project monitoring and evaluation. The fifth component, contingency emergency response (CERC) will provide preparedness and rapid response measures to address disaster, emergency and or catastrophic events in accordance with the applicable CERC manual.
To increase access to improved water supply and sanitation services in Blantyre Metropolitan Area, and to enhance the operational and financial efficiency of the Blantyre Water Board.

condition.narrative: Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I. A.1. b) The Recipient shall cause the Project Implementing Entity to maintainthrough the implementation of the Project, a Project Implementation Unit comprising a Project manager, a financial managementspecialist, a procurement officer, five engineers, an environmental, health, and safety officer, a social and gender officer, amonitoring and evaluation specialist and communication and community liaison officer, all with skills, experience, and terms ofreference satisfactory to the Association. c) Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (b) above, the Recipient shall ensurethat no later than ninety (90) days from the Effectiveness Date, the Project Implementing Entity recruits and thereafter maintainsthroughout the implementation of the Project, additional staff comprising a procurement specialist, environmental, health andsafety specialist and social safeguards specialist, and communications specialist, all with skills, experience and under terms ofreference satisfactory to the Association.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I. B.2. In implementing Parts 2, 3 (b), and 4(b) of the Project, the Recipient shallnot later than thirty (30) days from the Effectiveness Date ensure that the Project Implementing Entity enters into an agreement(Implementation Agreement) with the Blantyre City Council outlining the obligations of the parties satisfactory to the Association. Except as the Association shall otherwise agree, the Recipient shall not assign, amend, abrogate, or waive the ImplementationAgreement or any of its provisions.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I. D.1. The Recipient shall recruit, not later than sixty (60) days after the EffectiveDate, and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, an independent verification agent (“Verification Agent”) withqualification, experience, and under terms of reference satisfactory to the Association to undertake the verification of compliancewith the PBCs in accordance with the Verification Protocol.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I. D.1.The Recipient shall ensure that the Verification Agent, not later than thirty (30) days after the verification of compliance with or achievement of the PBCs for the pertinent calendar year has been completed,prepares and furnishes to the Recipient, who shall, in turn, furnish to the Association, a report on the results of saidverification process of such scope and in such detail as the Association shall reasonably request.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I. E.7.For purposes of implementing Part1(a) of the Project, the Recipient shall ensurethat the Project Implementing Entity shall establish, not later than twelve (12) months after the Effective Date, and thereaftermaintain throughout the implementation of the Project, for a panel of dam safety experts, with composition, functions, experience,and resources satisfactory to the Association.
